cards_1_to_3.note: 100% one_diamond for each of slots 1-3. Individual card example: 1.538% (for one specific ♦ card).

card_6.note: Card 6 is always a shiny rarity. one_shiny and two_shiny are separate from the standard ☆/☆☆ rarities.
